> LLM-generated review from https://github.com/canonical/maas-code-reviewer.
> Intended to assist a human reviewer, not replace one — suggestions may be
> incorrect, please verify before acting.


Docs-only change: bulk conversion of U+2019 apostrophes to ASCII in five files plus two link swaps. The Juju link (canonical.com/juju) is live and already used in docs/how-to-guides/get-started/index.md, so that change is consistent. Two issues block a clean merge: (1) docs/explanation/security.md now points at https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019, which is a 404 — the new Ubuntu Wiki (MediaWiki 1.46.2) did not migrate the legacy Community Help pages, and the URL is not in `linkcheck_ignore` in docs/conf.py, so `make -C docs linkcheck` will flag it; (2) the apostrophe normalization is incomplete in docs/explanation/deploying-machines.md (5 U+2019 remain, including the paragraph immediately after the edited line), leaving mixed typography in a file the PR claims to normalize. Note also that this repo lints docs with Vale and pymarkdownlnt (docs/Makefile), not proselint; proselint's only quote rule is `typography.symbols.curly_quotes`, which targets straight double quotes, not apostrophes, so the apostrophe edits are cosmetic rather than lint-driven. Small prose defects on lines touched by this PR in use-cases-server-lifecycle-management.md should be fixed in the same pass.

docs/explanation/security.md.110: This link is dead: https://wiki.ubuntu.com/Full_Disk_Encryption_Howto_2019 returns HTTP 404, and a wiki search for the page title returns no results (the new Ubuntu Wiki at wiki.ubuntu.com did not migrate legacy Community Help content; archives live at github.com/ubuntu/wiki-archives). Since the URL is not covered by `linkcheck_ignore` in docs/conf.py, `make -C docs linkcheck` will report it as broken. Prefer a maintained target such as https://documentation.ubuntu.com/security/security-features/storage/encryption-full-disk/ (verified live), or link the archived page explicitly.

docs/explanation/deploying-machines.md.40: Normalization is incomplete in this file: U+2019 apostrophes remain at lines 19 (`you’ve`), 27 and 33 (`machine’s`), 42 (`machine’s`, the very next paragraph), and 80 (`curtin’s`). This hunk changes one of six occurrences in the same file, so the result is mixed typography. Either convert the remaining five or drop this hunk and keep the file consistent.

docs/uncategorized/use-cases-server-life.31: This line still has a broken sentence on a line this PR rewrites: "...very large supercomputing installations. and its bare-metal focus..." should be one sentence (replace the period with a comma: "installations, and its bare-metal focus"). Two similar defects survive on other touched lines: line 15 has "in MAAS.(as referenced by" (missing space, stray period) and line 71 has "in 1-2 years.– and tooling" (stray period before the dash). Worth fixing while these lines are already being edited.
